description: Fund flows as ETFIQ computes them: daily change in shares outstanding times NAV. With ticker: that fund's net flow over 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD and 1Y with dates, share of starting net assets and streak. Without: the biggest inflows and outflows among funds with daily data for window (default 1W), funds counted, each row's last day (through), and the latest weekly report. Filter by desk, category or issuer.

category.description: Optional: only funds in this category. Ignored when ticker is given.

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk, such as leverage. Ignored when ticker is given.

issuer.description: Optional: only funds from this issuer. Ignored when ticker is given.

limit.description: Most rows in each ranked list, 1 to 50. Default 10.

ticker.description: Optional: one fund's flows, such as SPY. Omit for the ranked lists.

window.description: The window the flows cover. Default 1W.

name: etf_flows

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
